qualification_scope: Verified source/version configuration, complete trace timings and zero runtime failures. Cross-framework semantic mask agreement and full-language equivalence are not established.
table_quantile_method: NumPy-compatible linear interpolation; mean is arithmetic

timing_scope.runtime_clock: Python thread_time_ns at native adapter boundary for all frameworks
timing_scope.mask: Native fill_mask/fill_next_token_bitmask call including FFI; excludes packed-array reset and conversion to CFA boolean mask
timing_scope.commit: Native commit/consume adapter call including FFI and adapter checks; excludes full-vocabulary comparison/oracle work
timing_scope.tbm: Same-pass mask+commit for token k, then elementwise minimum across measured passes; not sum of separately minimized mask and commit
timing_scope.build: Grammar compiler elapsed wall time, with vocabulary prepared outside per-grammar timer. Excludes worker startup/IPC, parent load/start, artifact serialization, tokenizer loading, shared vocabulary preparation; build_wall values separately retained. Selected minimum of actual build runs. A 0.5-second cumulative build budget capped Static at one measured build.
timing_scope.ttfm: Canonical CFA build_seconds + selected first-mask time for each of31 examples; excludes tokenizer/vocab setup, artifact loading/state startup and process-launch overhead. Derived31 values share one grammar build minimum.
timing_scope.warmup: One unrecorded traversal per framework/example; excluded from measured values. Canonical cache isolation policies retained; no warm-runtime override.
timing_scope.timing_counts: Static 20, Dynamic 1 and llguidance 1 measured traversals per example.
timing_scope.quantiles: NumPy linear quantiles over all4099 selected per-token values; numeric units encoded in field names
timing_scope.correctness: 31 known fixture texts/4099 target tokens replayed without EOS append. Canonical expected_valid is null; no completed-program oracle or full-language equivalence qualification.

qualification_limitations: Uses unchanged canonical companion JS grammar policies; no full-language equivalence claim.
Static20 measured passes versus Dynamic/llguidance1pass follows canonical example-js counts; one excluded warmup each.
Build and TTFM exclude vocabulary preparation, state loading/startup and process overhead, as recorded in timing_scope.

ttfm_single.definition: Shared selected grammar-build wall time plus initial trace first-mask calling-thread CPU time
